title: 第15章 残忍的慈悲第16章 桃花赌约
slug: 梦中强吻女帝被找上门了怎么办
content_zh:
阴暗的小巷，恰巧没有其他人路过。
翠衣少女停下脚步，转身打量捕快，道：“有什么悄悄话，就在这里说吧。”
捕快一双贼眼左右张望，细心聆听四周，想要再一次确定附近没有旁人打扰。
“放心吧，这里只有我们两个。官爷想说什么，想做什么，都不用有什么顾忌……”轻柔的话语从少女花瓣般的双唇说出，仿佛带着恶魔的诱惑。
捕快的贼眼盯住她，目光无法遏制地变得炽烈起来。
他咽下一口口水，呼吸急促地道：“小姑娘，我想给你看一样宝贝。”
翠衣少女露出天真甜美的笑容：“是什么宝贝呢？”
“姑娘看仔细了，那就是……”捕快见少女的眼瞳像猫儿似的睁大，他嘴角的笑容逐渐变得狰狞，忽然右手一扬，捏碎了一粒香丸。
顿有一团白色雾气喷洒而出，笼罩了翠衣少女身形。
捕快面带狞笑得意地挥手：“倒也，倒也！”
他看着翠衣少女的剪影在白雾中摇曳，不等她完全栽倒，就已按捺不住心中的渴望，喘着粗气张开双臂扑过去。
“嘿嘿嘿！大爷现在就给你看宝贝——”
眼看就要扑中那具纤秀的身躯，他口中突然发出“嗷”的一声怪叫，以更快的速度反弹回来，结结实实地撞上墙壁，后背都陷入石墙几分，又慢慢滑落地面。
情势急转直下，捕快一时都没反应过来怎么回事，坐在地面上茫然呼痛。
翠衣少女从白雾中款款走出，依旧带着甜美的微笑，缓缓踱到他跟前：“你的宝贝呢？不会就这吧？”
捕快神色转为惶恐，粗喘着大气：“你……你是什么人？”
“我是一个……喜欢说悄悄话的小姑娘。”翠衣少女低头俯视他，甜美的笑容变得诡异起来，“刚才的悄悄话，还没有说完呢！”
“我不敢了！我错了！求求你饶了我……”
“你不愿意听我说悄悄话？”少女哀怨的眼神，仿佛能融化最硬的钢铁。
“我愿意！我愿意！只要你饶——”

“是你说的，你愿意。”少女高兴地点头，向捕快伸出右手，似乎想拉他起来，“我就知道，你不忍心让我失望。”
捕快战战兢兢地握住那只纤白的玉手，还没来得及说出更多讨饶的话，突然手上一紧，耳边风声呼啸，只觉如腾云驾雾一般，身躯凌空飞了起来。
翠衣少女手掌探出，以弹奏乐曲般的巧妙手法飞快地拂过捕快的脊椎，捏断了骨头，和周身大筋。
她的动作精准美妙，如行云流水，毫无滞碍。就趁捕快一抛一落的工夫，已完成了所有敲打。
然后她往后退开几步，在鲜血洒落之前，像是欣赏一件艺术品一般，欣赏着捕快落地的姿态。
“噗通”一响之后，灰尘和鲜血一同四溅。
捕快仿佛这时才反应过来，惊恐和剧痛的尖叫声在巷子里响起。
content_en:
It was a dark alley where no one else happened to be passing by.
The girl in green clothes stopped, turned around, looked at the policeman, and said, "If you have any secrets, just say them here."
The detective looked around with ruthless eyes and listened carefully to his surroundings, trying to make sure again that no one was disturbing him nearby.
"Don't worry, there are only two of us here. You don't have to worry about what you want to say or what you want to do..." The soft words came out of the girl's petal-like lips, as if with the temptation of the devil.
The detective's thief eyes were fixed on her, and his gaze became uncontrollably intense.
He swallowed a mouthful of saliva and breathed quickly: "Little girl, I want to show you a treasure."
The girl in green clothes showed an innocent and sweet smile: "What kind of treasure is it?"
"Girl, look carefully, that's..." The catcher saw the girl's eyes widening like a cat, the smile on his lips gradually turned ferocious, and suddenly he raised his right hand and crushed a fragrant pill.
Suddenly a ball of white mist sprayed out, covering the figure of the girl in green clothes.
The policeman waved his hand proudly with a ferocious smile on his face: "That's right, that's right!"
He watched the silhouette of the girl in green robes swaying in the white mist. Before she could fall down completely, he could no longer suppress the desire in his heart, gasping for air and pounced on her with open arms.
"Hey hey hey! I will show you my baby now——"
Just as he was about to hit the slender body, he suddenly let out a strange cry of "ouch" and bounced back at a faster speed, hitting the wall firmly. His back sank into the stone wall for a while, and then slowly slid to the ground.
The situation took a turn for the worse, and the policeman didn't even realize what was going on. He sat on the ground and cried out in pain.
The girl in green clothes walked out of the white mist, still with a sweet smile, and walked slowly to him: "Where is your baby? Isn't this all?"
The detective's expression turned to panic, and he gasped: "You... who are you?"
"I am a...little girl who likes to whisper." The girl in green clothes lowered her head and looked down at him, her sweet smile turned weird, "I haven't finished the whisper just now!"
"I don't dare anymore! I was wrong! Please forgive me..."
"You don't want to listen to my whispers?" The girl's plaintive eyes seemed to melt the hardest steel.
"I do! I do! As long as you spare—"
"You said it, you are willing." The girl nodded happily and stretched out her right hand to the detective, as if she wanted to pull him up. "I knew you couldn't bear to let me down."
The detective held the delicate white jade hand tremblingly. Before he could say more words of mercy, his hand suddenly tightened. The wind roared in his ears, and he felt like a cloud and mist, and his body flew up in the air.
The girl in green clothes reached out with her palm, and quickly brushed across the prisoner's spine with a deft technique like playing music, crushing the bones and muscles all over her body.
Her movements were precise and beautiful, flowing like clouds and flowing water without any hindrance. Just as the catcher was throwing and dropping, all the beatings were completed.
Then she took a few steps back and before the blood was spilled, she admired the arrester's landing posture as if appreciating a piece of art.
After the "pop" sound, dust and blood splashed everywhere.
The policeman seemed to have reacted at this moment, and screams of panic and pain echoed in the alley.
